commands.freq_set: payload is a finite number within freq_limits[<normal_min|hunt_s>]
ticket_rules: The payload is the JSON text of an object (not an array, a string or null).
Its keys are a subset of keys, include every key in required and, when any_of is given, at least one of any_of.
Every key present is checked by its fields entry; a null value is the wrong type.

text: a JSON string whose length in Unicode code points (Python len, JavaScript [...s].length) is from min to max; with pattern, the whole string matches it (Python re.fullmatch; JavaScript new RegExp(pattern) with no flags and the pattern's own ^ and $), so a trailing newline is refused.
text is well-formed Unicode: no lone surrogate (Python: s.encode('utf-8') succeeds; JavaScript: s.isWellFormed()).
int: a JSON number, never a boolean or a string, with a whole value from min to max; 2.0 counts as 2 (JavaScript cannot tell them apart); 2.5, true, "2" and 1e999 are refused.
enum: a JSON string equal to one of values.
le: each [a, b] means the value of a is at most the value of b.
nonempty_when: each {field, is, then} means that when field equals is, then is present with at least 1 code point.
commands.shape_rules: commands.shapes are read with commands.ticket_rules, as commands.tickets are
pilot_upload_checks: one upload at a time; chunks in order (the same chunk again counts once), the next within stale_s
every chunk carries the same uid, kind, month, size, sha and parts; parts is the base64 length over chunk_chars
kind pairings or award; month this HST month or one of the next months_ahead
at most per_day uploads put together in 24 h
the whole base64 decodes strictly, to size bytes (at most file_bytes) whose sha256 is sha
%PDF- at the start and %%EOF in the last 1024 bytes
text from pdftotext -layout in a child process: extract_timeout_s, extract_mem_mb of memory, extract_cpu_s of CPU
pairings: names that month's Pairing Package, at least min_pairings pairings, at least one A332 HNL pairing
award: names that month and holds the pilot's own line (his employee number from his FLICA schedule)
the same file as the one on file is not stored again
nothing on file for that month and kind: used at once; else held for the admin, read by no instance
